description: Rodinia Backpropagation: one training epoch of the input->hidden layer of a neural net. Faithful port of the original two GPU kernels: bpnn_layerforward_CUDA (16x16 shared-memory tiled forward pass with an in-block log-step reduction tree) and bpnn_adjust_weights_cuda (weight/momentum update). The output layer and delta math run on the CPU in the original and are not GPU-timed. One recorded pass = forward + weight-adjust; one record per kernel.

scaling_param.name: input
scaling_param.description: Input layer size (number of input neurons). Must be a multiple of 16; one 16-row block per 16 input units. The original standard run uses 65536.

non_scaling_params.name: hidden
non_scaling_params.description: Hidden layer size. Fixed at 16: the kernels tile with HEIGHT=WIDTH=16 and index the weight matrix with a (hid+1) stride, so hid==16 is baked into the original algorithm (not a tunable knob).
